278458172.description:
You are purchasing a "Carved Figural Face Smoking Pipe with Case" in "Used" condition.
Striking figural smoking pipe with a finely carved white bowl in the shape of a bearded man wearing a feathered hat, paired with a rich amber-brown curved stem. The carving has excellent detail in the facial features, beard, and hat, giving it a bold display presence whether you smoke it or showcase it in a collection. The pipe comes with a fitted hard case, shaped precisely to the pipe for protection and easy storage. The interior lining cradles the pipe, while the exterior has a classic black finish with brass-tone hardware that adds a vintage look. Perfect for pipe collectors, display in a study or smoking room, or as a distinctive gift for someone who appreciates unique, sculptural pipes. Keywords: figural pipe, carved face pipe, decorative smoking pipe, collectible pipe, curved stem pipe, pipe with case, display pipe
Condition Notes:
Pipe bowl and stem appear clean with no obvious chips or cracks. Carved figural face and hat show sharp detail without visible damage. Stem shows no major bite marks or deep wear at the mouthpiece. Fitted hard case exterior shows surface scuffs, edge wear, small abrasions, and finish wear, while the interior lining appears intact but with light soiling from use. See pictures for reference. Sold as-is.
Aspects:
Color: White bowl with amber-brown stem
Body Shape: Figural face bowl with curved stem
